data.name: customSqlQuery1.Sql
data.value: select "stores"."area_code" as 'Area Code',"accounts"."id" as 'Code', "accounts"."name" as 'Name', "accounts"."father_name" as 'Father Name', "accounts"."phone" as 'Office Phone', "accounts"."home_phone" as 'Home Phone',"accounts"."balance" as 'Balance' from ("dbo"."accounts" "accounts" left join "dbo"."stores" "stores" on ("stores"."id" = "accounts"."store_id")) WHERE accounts.account_group_id='1002'

data.name: customSqlQuery2.Sql
data.value: select accounts.id as 'Code',accounts.name as 'Name',accounts.phone as 'Office Phone',accounts.home_phone as 'Home Phone',aggrements.ref_no as 'Ref.No',a_d.emi_date as 'Due Date',a_d.emi_amount as 'Due Amount' from aggrement_dues as a_d left join aggrements on a_d.aggrement_id=aggrements.id right join accounts on aggrements.customer_id=accounts.id left join stores on accounts.store_id=stores.id WHERE accounts.account_group_id='1002' and convert(datetime,a_d.emi_date,103) < convert(datetime,DATEADD(day,-1,GETDATE()),103)
